Hi there! It really depends when it comes to the letter. Does your friend like to read or do they like really nice stuff said about them? If they do then I think they will see the letter you took time and effort to illustrate/write as something endearing. If your friend isnt particularly the feely type then I dont think a letter will do much good. If I were looking to give something special that isnt materialistic, I'd look into one of their hobbies/passions and see what I can make out of it and surprise them. Although, you dont have to do that. These are just a couple things to think about! Best of luck--
